What this is

Each brief describes what a doctor or operator can do and the rules that are decisions rather than implementation. No endpoints, no schemas.

How to use it

Open a feature, press Copy brief, paste it into Slo. It reads the repo and writes the spec.

What stays ours

The prompts, the slide template and the rulings. Those are attached to the features that need them.
